ni.name: AI agent for RF test data

thesis.heading: What is my thesis about?
thesis.answer: Most ISAC research treats radar cross-section as a random variable. In a network of nodes it depends on geometry, so I model it deterministically. That turns each node’s role, sensing or talking, into something the optimiser can choose.
thesis.problem: Joint node-role selection and beamforming in a multi-node V2X intersection network
thesis.method: Convex optimisation and successive convex approximation
thesis.status: Literature review and formulation done, convex solver in progress

ni.heading: What did I ship at NI Dresden?
ni.lead: A tool that lets manufacturing engineers query production test data without SQL or Python.
ni.fig_speed: faster after moving from pandas to Polars
ni.fig_rows: rows per dataset, cached as Parquet
ni.fig_types: measurement types ranked for failure patterns
ni.how: Engineers ask things like “show me the yield for VST channel 4 last week” and get tables and Plotly charts back. An LLM agent skill routes each question to a Python pipeline; a 1σ/3σ classifier splits real failures from marginal cases and noise.
ni.wrong: I underestimated the cost of repeated metadata queries. It was stable, but too slow for a conversation.
ni.change: Put heavy processing behind a cache from day one. If an answer takes 30 seconds, people stop asking.
